title: Two Higgs Doublet Model from Six Dimensional Gauge Theory
summary: We improve our previously proposed two Higgs doublet model of six-dimensional $SU(4)$ gauge theory compactified on an orbifold $T^2/Z_2$ by introducing the brane localized gauge kinetic terms. Since two Higgs doublets are identified with massless zero modes in extra spatial components of the six-dimensional gauge field, the Higgs sector in our model is constrained by the six-dimensional gauge symmetry.
